about_short_description.short_description: The world’s leading solution for consolidating lab communication, inventory management, and lab supply purchasing.

product.name: Lab Inventory Management
product.description: A customizable system to track lab supplies, quantities, locations, and related data such as expiration dates and safety data sheets.

product.name: Lab Supply Request Management
product.description: A centralized platform for submitting, approving, and tracking lab supply requests and orders within a lab team.

product.name: Quartzy Shop
product.description: An online marketplace offering over 10 million lab products from 1,800+ life science brands for direct purchase.

product.name: Procurement System Integrations
product.description: Integrations with accounting, procurement, communication, and R&D software to synchronize lab management data and automate workflows.

product.name: Mobile Access and Barcode Management
product.description: Mobile app features for inventory tracking, barcode label creation, and barcode scanning to manage lab supplies on the go.
